cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved coffee together on Sunday. That year apart was healthy for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You used to insist on every Saturday, whatever else I wanted to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The break taught us to have separate lives. I'm authorizing a much more flexible arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked pottery this Sunday. Can coffee wait?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Monday is approved. See how well the break worked? You've requested a whole extra day apart, and I haven't called an emergency meeting.

heightening.evidence: B4 delay request becomes A5 immediate evidence of improved tolerance, while A still treats it as permission to grant.
